headline: Conditionally approved a 105,000 square foot warehouse at 12 Jack's Bridge Road; recommended zoning changes on parking and accessory dwelling units.
summary: The approval included a waiver for trees 15" or greater in diameter. One resident questioned the 40% size cap on accessory dwelling units during a public hearing. Members also discussed possible rules for data centers.
decisions: Approved the tree waiver for the 12 Jack's Bridge Road warehouse plan, 8-0.
Conditionally approved the site plan for the 105,000 square foot warehouse at 12 Jack's Bridge Road, 8-0.
Recommended to the Town Council proposed zoning amendments on residential parking, Class VI and private roads, and accessory dwelling units, 8-0.
Deferred action on proposed amendments to the Site Plan Regulations, 8-0.

decision_evidence.quote: J. Farrell made a motion to approve the waiver as presented, flipping A and B. A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.

J. Farrell made a motion for conditional approval of 12 Jack's Bridge Road, Tax Map 15, Lot 103-1, for all of the precedent conditions and general and subsequent conditions that have been discussed and are in the memo. J. Knights seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.

J. Farrell made a motion for residential parking zoning ordinance RSA 674:16, Part 7; Class VI roads and private roads RSA 674:41; and Accessory Dwelling Units RSA 674:71-73, for all of these proposed amendments to be recommended to the Londonderry Town Council. T. DeFrancesco seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Farrell made a motion to defer action on the proposed amendments to the Site Plan Regulations. A. Rugg seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
